in_marathi.name: Anant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anant means one who is boundless, infinite, endless, and eternal. It is the name of the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is considered to be the sustainer of the universe.
